rows.grounds: locative of place where recitation is performed

items.question: What ritual arrangement governs recitation performed with a great conch placed above?
premises: A great conch is to be placed in the recitation place.
The great conch is positioned above.
The practitioner should act while reciting.
items.inference: Recitation should be practiced with a great conch placed above in the recitation place.
items.plain_english: Having placed a great conch above in the place of recitation, one should practice while reciting.
